licences.axe-core: MPL-2.0 (axe.min.js loaded unmodified from node_modules; nothing bundled or edited)

install.command: npm i axe-core@4.14.0 playwright-core@1.64.1  (+ a Chromium: npx playwright-core install chromium, ~150 MB, not counted here)
install.windows: yes: Node-only; Chromium/Edge binary on Windows is supported by Playwright

fixtures: fixtures/02-axe (KEY.json): 6 seeded pages A1..A6, 6 clean pages (review, sign-up form, interactive figure, table, video page, FAQ)

baseline.what: our own three checks: unlabelled inputs, tap targets < 24 px (controls), outline:none rules; Playwright script runs/02-axe/baseline.mjs
baseline.note: With inline text links included in the tap-target check (a literal reading of the rule) the baseline flags all 6 clean pages (nav links ~20 px tall); the number above excludes inline links, the fairer reading.

candidate_default.config: axe.run(document) with defaults (all rules incl. best-practice)

candidate_tuned.config: runOnly tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa; resultTypes violations

limits: A6 (script keyboard trap) is not detectable by axe; it needs a keyboard-driving test (Tab/Escape loop). Keep that one in our own script.
axe checks the rendered DOM state only: dialogs that are hidden until a click are not analysed unless the test opens them.
Contrast on text over images/gradients comes back 'incomplete', not a violation; the wrapper reports incomplete separately.
Runtime ~0.3 s per page after the browser is up; the browser start is ~0.5 s.
reason: 5/6 seeded defects vs 1/6 for our script, 0 false positives on 6 clean pages, 17 MB install, ~4 s for 12 pages. Keep our tap-target and keyboard checks alongside it.
